task_intent: Refine five Tessera games with expressive native boards and matching wall compositions.

features.mobbin_query: Sliding tile picture puzzle with album artwork, numbered tiles, move counter and shuffle state

references.applied_idea: Artwork remains the dominant object; an unmistakable missing piece teaches the action. Applied a calm gap marker, directly adjacent legal tile outlines and full-square artwork.
Art is presented as an object worth looking at, with concise difficulty context. Applied a small3×3/4×4 label and unobscured finished sleeve rather than a banner covering it.
The play area dominates while brief timer/progress feedback stays peripheral. Kept move count and tiles-home progress outside the shared composition.

references.title: Princeton: Slider Puzzle
references.applied_idea: Tiles move orthogonally into the gap; legal walks preserve solvability. Retained seeded legal scrambling, added strict tile validation and tests for adjacent moves, reversal and final whole-image restoration.

features.limitations: Mobbin returned related picture puzzle and casual-game interfaces rather than a dedicated album-art sliding screen.

features.mobbin_query: Music guessing game revealing an album cover with answer input, time progress and completed result

references.applied_idea: A large remaining-time figure and directly reachable answer controls make a timed music question easy to understand. Applied a restrained countdown beside the header and inline guess/send control under the artwork.
Music and artwork are paired through recognition. Kept the sleeve central and its identity hidden until the round completes.
A clear correctness state above content separates the outcome from the input. Applied a compact recognized-time/artist/album result outside the image and retained recent guesses.

references.title: Asynchronously loading images into table and collection views
references.applied_idea: Load image data asynchronously, avoid repeating large image payloads in status snapshots, and retain usable content while loading. Integrated the shared session-pinned high-resolution production-frame canvas.

references.title: Reduce screen motion on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch
references.applied_idea: Respect Reduce Motion for transitions. Removed the old completion flash and gate native transitions with the accessibility environment.

features.limitations: Mobbin references are adjacent recognition/timed-music interfaces, not a matching album-cover reveal implementation.
